questions.question: Name a cereal box, a tent and an unsharpened pencil as prisms, and explain how you named them.
questions.expected_answer: A prism is named by its end faces. The cereal box has rectangle ends, so it is a rectangular prism. The tent has triangle ends, so it is a triangular prism. The pencil has hexagon ends, so it is a hexagonal prism.

questions.question: Give two ways a cube and a cereal box are the same and two ways they are different.
questions.expected_answer: Same: both have 6 flat faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices, and all faces are rectangles. Different: a cube has 6 equal square faces and all edges equal, while the cereal box has faces of different sizes and edges of different lengths.

questions.question: Describe a cylinder and a cone, and say how they are different.
questions.expected_answer: A cylinder has 2 flat circle faces and 1 curved surface. A cone has 1 flat circle face, 1 curved surface and an apex. The cone has only one circle and comes to a point; the cylinder has two circles and no point.
